headline_seed: Trainee driver crashes bus into River Seine
description_seed: The driver hit a parked car and veered off the road into the river - about 12 miles south of Paris - early on Thursday.

what: Trainee driver crashes bus into River Seine

clean_source_blocks.text: The driver hit a parked car and veered off the road into the river - about 12 miles south of Paris - early on Thursday.
A trainee drove a bus into the River Seine after hitting a parked car and veering off the road on Thursday morning, officials have said.

JUVISY-SUR-ORGE, France – Four people were rescued from the River Seine near Paris on April 30 after a bus driven by a trainee driver collided with a parked vehicle before plunging into the water, officials said.
A trainee bus driver has plunged a coach into the River Seine as rescuers dived to rapidly haul passengers from the water.
